units.B3: excluded: working assumption restating #1/#2 (keep following the returned URL, record C:D20) and listing undecided alternatives (same-origin credentials, refusal); open question repo.remote.download.credentials

obligations.text: To install from a remote registry IPM asks for the package URL and hash, then downloads that URL exactly as returned (not a path relative to the repository).
obligations.cases: returned URL on the configured origin vs another origin
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter4 registry.rs; control bytes-sent-to-configured-origin rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m57)

obligations.text: IPM sends the repository credentials on both the metadata and the byte request, even when the URL names a different server.
obligations.cases: cross-origin vs same-origin URL with Basic and token configured
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter4 registry.rs; control bytes-drop-credentials-as-built rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m58)

obligations.text: Artifactory byte downloads send no credentials.

parent.entailment: The parent owns the URL-following and credential-forwarding rules (graded directly). Redirect, integrity and token behaviour are owned by the children; no composition credited.

obligations.text: Registry requests follow HTTP redirects automatically and send the same credentials on each hop, so a same-server URL redirecting elsewhere still delivers Basic credentials and the API key there.
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter5 redirect.rs; control redirect-drops-credentials-as-built rejected). Scope: download hops; metadata/listing redirects share the builder but were not exercised; iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m124)

obligations.text: Checking only the URL the registry returns would not stop the redirect leak; a fix must decide credentials per hop or stop following redirects itself.
obligations.cases: s14 (first-hop check) vs s14b (per-hop) on [local, other]
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter5 redirect.rs; controls s14-checks-every-hop, s14b-checks-first-hop rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m125, G4-m126)

obligations.text: When the registry gives a hash, the downloaded file's lowercase SHA-1 must equal it exactly, so an uppercase hash of the same digest is refused.
obligations.cases: matching vs zero vs uppercase hash
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter4 registry.rs; control hash-compared-case-insensitively rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m59)

obligations.text: A mismatch fails the install; no install token is kept and no install report is sent.
obligations.observation: install status; token stored; analytics sent
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter4 registry.rs; control mismatch-sends-analytics rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m61, G4-m62)

obligations.text: An empty hash skips the check; non-archive bytes then pass the download, extract to nothing and fail later with a missing-manifest error after the install report was sent.
obligations.cases: empty hash with junk bytes vs valid archive
obligations.observation: download result; install error; analytics sent
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter4 registry.rs; controls empty-hash-rejected, junk-refused-at-download rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): partial, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m60, G4-m64)
obligations.gap: Rule 4a (iteration-72): rule 4a: "extract to nothing" is a fixture input (gzip_ok=false, has_manifest=false), not derived from the archive reader (iter3 artifacts.rs::header_action); removing the gzip decision (G4-m64) verifies. Empty-hash skip (m60) and report-before-failure are pinned.

obligations.text: A failed metadata request reports its HTTP status; a failed download reports only that the status was not 200.
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter4 registry.rs; control bytes-failure-reports-status rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m63, G4-m65)

obligations.text: The registry may return an install token; IPM keeps it only after the hash check passes.
obligations.cases: accepted vs mismatch download with a token
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter4 registry.rs; control token-stored-before-integrity rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m62)

obligations.text: IPM sends the kept token once with the install report and then deletes it.
obligations.cases: report sent with stored token vs a second report
obligations.observation: token in the report; temp entry after the report
obligations.gap: No model of Repo/Remote/PackageService.cls::SendAnalyticsToRegistry reading and killing ^IRIS.TempZPMRInst; native R-analytics only. Missing contrast: first report carries tok-same and the entry is gone; a second report for the same module carries no token.

obligations.text: A token takes precedence over a complete username and password; incomplete Basic credentials use anonymous search.
obligations.cases: token+basic vs basic only vs user without password
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; controls token-loses-precedence, incomplete-basic-is-credential rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m01, G4-m02)

obligations.text: As built (C:D17), credentials are attached to the metadata request but the byte download is a new anonymous request, so a server requiring the token for bytes fails the download while a public byte endpoint succeeds.
obligations.cases: server requiring Bearer vs anonymous at the byte endpoint
obligations.basis: reused:download-security metadata (iter3 artifacts.rs; control bytes-request-reuses-token-as-built rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m03)

obligations.text: The byte download must return HTTP 200; success in search does not establish permission to fetch the artifact.
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70 (save_download refuses status!=200; credentials_cross_endpoint gives metadata 200 with bytes 401); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G4): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G4-m04)
